dog.description_text: Meet Cashmere — She is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Cashmere, an 11-year-old female, is sweet and very social. She loves to be pet and enjoys 'talking" with you. She is playful and a great companion. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FCashmere%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQqY3FV7wMEqSKvv1kbETxasEgUCV%5FEnIZkg%2DYQLtlLA9LYtBg Her foster says "After a few days of adjustment, Cashmere's personality has really come out! She loves to cuddle, gets excited to be brushed, likes to explore her surroundings, enjoys Cat TV, and purrs for you whenever you give her chin scratches! She has so much love to give and enjoys getting the love right back from you! Cashmere makes me laugh every time I come home because she meows to say hello every time without fail! She's one of the most loving cats I've ever been with. She loves to cuddle with you, play with you, and talk to you. Some of her favorite things: Being brushed, playing with a command clip or string toy, chirping at cat TV, sleeping with you, and basking in the sun. Some other quirks about her: Whenever you approach her to pet her on the head, she trills (almost like she has an easy button) and it makes me laugh every time. Once you pet her (and she truly loves pets anywhere but especially on her head, cheek, and chin), she then becomes a purring machine until you stop. She loves to keep you company during your downtime, and she loves to get zoomies when it's playtime. She talks to you when she knows you're about to feed her, just to make sure you remember she's there. She very much likes her routine everyday and follows it like clockwork. She enjoys exploring and being social. But her absolute favorite thing in the world is her human, without a doubt! She's so ready for her forever home, and for someone to love her as unconditionally as she will love them." She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
